**Premium status** supports Car Scanner ELM OBD2 **2.2.52 (arm64)** and **2.2.42 (arm64 and x86_64)**, with existing **2.2.21** and **2.1.50** support preserved. Select either **Car Scanner - Premium status** or **Car Scanner - Premium status (Experimental)**; both are disabled by default and must be used separately. The experimental alternative has no version-name restriction: it reuses the reviewed exact implementation for known builds and, for an unknown build, locates the premium getter and ECU predicate structurally (by metadata identity and the Mono AOT method-address table), rebuilds the store generically, and fails safe if any target cannot be found. This is best-effort, not an automatic port — a genuinely changed future binary may still need review.

The 2.2.52 implementation reuses the same managed/compiled premium and ECU transforms. Its guard and decoder libraries are byte-identical to earlier versions, and its assembly block is already four-byte aligned (no padding needed). Host verification, packaged bundle application for both alternatives, and a byte-for-byte proof that the experimental generic fallback reproduces the exact 2.2.52 result all pass; device behaviour and ECU connectivity are unverified. See [2.2.52 implementation and verification details](docs/CarScanner252.md).

The 2.2.42 implementation covers managed and compiled premium/ECU predicates, settings and profile decoding, and the native delayed exit after repackaging. Both alternatives passed host verification, bundle application and unsigned APK rebuilding. The arm64 phone original and the earlier x86_64 emulator original have separate reviewed implementations. The alignment fix in the refreshed v0.18.1 release passes emulator model-selection and restart-persistence checks; ECU connectivity remains unverified. The arm64 correction requires the updated bundle; published 0.18.0 originally covered only x86_64. See [2.2.42 implementation and verification details](docs/CarScanner242.md).

For 2.2.21, the user reported successful device operation including ECU connection. Emulator settings persistence tests passed, and the user confirmed correct operation on 2026-10-30. These historical results do not establish device behavior on 2.2.42; individual premium features and purchase/restore behavior have not all been verified. See [2.2.21 details](docs/CarScanner221.md).
